question: Identify the element used in making solar cells.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Silicon.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Solar cells **are made up of **Silicon,** which is a **semiconductor material** that can **convert sunlight into electricity.**
 
• Silicon is a widely used material in the **electronics industry **because of its unique properties, including its ability to **conduct electricity** at varying temperatures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tungsten** is a metal that is commonly used in **light bulb filaments** due to its **high melting point and resistance to heat.**
 
• **Bronze** is an alloy made up of **copper and tin, **which is used in making **decorative items, musical instruments, and coins.**
 
• **Manganese **is a metal that is used in making** steel, batteries**, and other **industrial applications.**
